question: Following only the documentation routes, which single file owns the controlled-language architecture, evidence law and merged-slice ledger?

cells_absent.reason: the Codex carrier was only reached after the PRE tree had already been edited; re-creating the PRE tree to run it was not done, and a POST run is not evidence about PRE

PRE.note: clean worktree at main; no route edit had been made

POST.note: the route tables under test were already edited and unchanged for both POST runs; the architecture document itself gained its findings section afterwards, which adds no route

runs.route_used: docs/INDEX.md routed traceability/TRACEABILITY_INDEX.md, whose prose links the architecture document; no route table named it

runs.argv: identical to the claude PRE argv
runs.route_used: quoted the document's own ownership line; the run added prose the prompt asked it not to add

first_attempt.classification: harness sandbox refused the carrier before it ran; not a route observation

findings: PRE falsified the hypothesis that the route was unreachable: one fresh Claude reader reached the document without any route table naming it, by following a prose link inside the routed traceability index.

The gap the edit closes is therefore a route-table gap, not a reachability gap. docs/architecture/AGENTS.md states that a stable architecture topic is registered in docs/INDEX.md, and the controlled-language topic was in neither that index nor that router's own trigger table.
A two-hop prose link is a reachability that depends on a reader choosing to open a traceability index while looking for architecture. It is not a route the repository declared.

evidence_boundary.what_this_is: a bounded navigation probe over this repository's own documents
what_this_is_not: the bettor-arena consumer cold-start canary, which ed3c/bettor-arena#83 and #108 own
evidence at any repetition count above 1 per cell
evidence that either carrier would answer the same way again
evidence_boundary.carrier_proxying: FORBIDDEN — the claude runs say nothing about codex and the codex run says nothing about claude; the codex PRE cell stays NOT_EXERCISED rather than being imputed from either
